summary: The global marketing team is executing a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top program priorities, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing urgent email access issues.
summaryDetail: The most critical initiative is the seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy, which prioritizes promoting Asia Star and Intelligent China over US partnership programs (Stanford, Columbia on hold; Berkeley under audit). This week, Joseph must draft the target areas/prompts document and analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads, while the team requests a brief on Google Ads conversion tracking setup. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team approved the two-menu structure, article page improvements, and dispersing videos by topic, but Joseph needs to share his HTML design file and hold a feedback session with Julie and the team lead to finalize changes before Joker implements them. Urgent IT issues include resolving Outlook account lockouts across devices by re-logging in, updating passwords, and contacting JSB to confirm backend unlock. Upcoming priorities include aligning on the Nov 13 EuroCham Shanghai event, reviewing the updated Homepage/Knowledge PPT, and responding to the Yili Group digitalization custom program enquiry, with ESG report drafting and AACSB 2027 Global Impact Award application already submitted.
